I just wanted to say THANK YOU! Your app has literally changed my life for the better. A year ago, I was 215lbs at 5’2” and freshly diagnosed with T2 diabetes. I’m 22, I thought my life was over - I’ve seen this play out in my family across generations. I was terrified of what my life would be. 

I started nutrition and diabetes education, and my educator told me about Ladder. I thought in my head “I’m screwed anyway, no reason to try.” But then I kept getting messages from Coach Nicole about starting my workouts, and I thought “maybe I’ll just work out to get this lady to leave me alone.” Best decision of my life. After 25 weeks of consistency in workouts and nutrition, I’m 152lbs and my diabetes is fully in remission. I had labs done and for the first time in my life EVERYTHING was normal. I’m no longer on that path anymore, and every day I think how grateful I am for the chance to change my life.

So, thank you for giving me the tools to save my own life.

This app has it all. From a wide range of educated fitness professionals to many differing styles of exercise. The format of the app is like having a one-on-one trainer in your ear. The built-in timer makes it easy to stay on track, along with the option to pause or skip sections. Swapping movements is easy, in case you don’t have certain equipment. I have recommended this app to several friends who’ve all downloaded it and love it. There is so much more I left out! If you’re on the fence, I highly recommend trying the 30-day free trial. You’ll be hooked. And you can’t beat the price!
Great workouts, great user experience ! Worth the subscription!
